mixture: In a bowl add 5 chopped tomatoes, 2 chopped onions, 5-6 garlic cloves & ½ inch ginger. Grind it well.
QMake a mixture of 100 gm grated paneer, 2 tbsp coriander, 2 tbsp mixed dry fruits, 2 green chilies, 2 tsp kashmiri red chili powder, ½ tsp garam masala, ½ tsp turmeric powder, ¼ tsp salt.
Take 6 papads, cut them in between. Apply water over it & keep the paneer stuffing on it. Join the edges, stick it properly. Shallow fry these stuffed papads in oil.
Now in a pan add 2 tbsp oil, 1 star anise, 2 bay leaves, 1 inch cinnamon, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 1 tsp cumin seeds & ground mixture also add 1 tsp salt into it. Cook it for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes add ½ tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp red chili powder into it. Cook it well & add ½ cup of water to it also add 3 tbsp fresh cream.
Keep fried papads into it. Garnish it with grated paneer & coriander.
Serve with roti, naan or rice!
coriander-chutney: Mix together potatoes,peas,garlic-green chilli paste,chutney,garam masala,coriander,breadcrumbs ,onion, and salt and bring it together like a dough.
Insert a chunk of paneer on an icecream stick and cover it with the mixture. Freeze for 20 mins.
Mix together refined flour,cornflour, salt and water to form a paste. —
Dip the lollipop in the paste, then coat with breadcrumbs.
Fry on medium flame till golden brown.
